product.regional_source: Simpson Strong-Tie U.K. official product page

applicability.bolt_resistance_basis: unresolved; source capacity table shown for CNA nails, not bolts

development_constraints: Use only the factory hole pattern; do not invent holes or transfer screw capacities to bolts.
Use one complete M10-class bolt/washer/nut stack only as a geometric prototype until the applicable bolt design basis is established.
Confirm AB90 is obtainable and acceptable for the installation jurisdiction before any purchase or shop instruction.
AB90 is not a universal replacement for all 24 stations; skew, access, edge distance, and load direction remain joint-specific.
decision: Use AB90 for bounded representative-joint and layout development. Do not call it a qualified structural connection or publish a purchase/drilling schedule yet.
